name: Zernote
description: Zernote helps companies understand their customers from real conversations. It's an AI analysis platform for UX researchers and research teams - and this connector makes your entire research library queryable inside Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zernote to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zernote to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://zernote.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zernote MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zernote provides these MCP tools: folders_read, folders_edit, interviews_read, interviews_edit, search, cards_read, jtbd_read, and upload_interview.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zernote?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Zernote in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Zernote requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Zernote is developed by Zernote Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
